decision_boundary: This configuration prepares a six-complex engineering repeatability check only. It is not an affinity benchmark, a blind test, or validation of GraphPep/FoldX/ESM against Kd.

literature_labels.uncertainty_note: These are source-reported fit intervals, not independent replicate SD/SEM or a new experimental validation.

study_scope.assay_to_model_mismatch: Assay peptide has N-terminal fluorescein and C-terminal amide; assay receptor includes an incompletely specified N-terminal c-myc/TEV junction. Model input omits these groups and is an explicit core-only proxy.
study_scope.input_format: Three FASTA records; each complex is receptor:peptide; chain A is receptor and chain B is peptide. Two seed runs yield at most six predicted complexes.

prediction.post_prediction_relaxation: Use existing workspace pipeline/relax_feedback_panel.py with the previously used CPU restrained Amber settings (200 iterations, 3 outer iterations, tolerance 2.39, stiffness 10); run serially and retain raw plus relaxed structures.

msa_policy.rationale: No local Bcl-w homolog MSA database or target-specific A3M was found. A remote MSA service has not been called; this draft avoids third-party service use.
msa_policy.deviation: The earlier application draft proposed a shared receptor MSA. This local single-sequence mode is an explicit pre-score method change and must remain attached to any result.

proposed_readouts_pre_score.identity_gate: Require exactly one receptor chain A matching the 164-aa core, one peptide chain B matching the exact 23-aa sequence, and contiguous residue mapping. Any mismatch is a failed complex and is retained in the denominator.
proposed_readouts_pre_score.contact_definition: Number of unique receptor-peptide residue pairs with any heavy-atom distance <= 6.0 A; zero-contact is a failure, not a missing row.
proposed_readouts_pre_score.pairing: For each candidate and seed, compare only with the parent predicted using the same seed. Do not pool receptors or average the two mutation directions.
proposed_readouts_pre_score.cross_seed_rule: Call a proxy direction seed-stable only if both seed-specific parent-minus-variant comparisons are finite, pass identity/quality/contact gates, and have the same nonzero sign. Otherwise classify unstable or failed.
proposed_readouts_pre_score.interpretation: A positive parent-minus-variant GraphPep or FoldX value means only proxy-score improvement. It does not mean lower Kd or improved complete binding free energy.

GraphPep.direction: lower raw PRED_SCORE is better; report parent score minus variant score per seed
GraphPep.command_template: bash graphpep_patched.sh protein.pdb decoys.pdb -out score.csv -each -outeach score_each.csv
GraphPep.no_contact_or_execution_error: failed row; retain in denominator; no fallback score
GraphPep.runtime_source_note: Use current workspace pipeline code from /mnt/e/Users/graphpep与pepmlm/pipeline. The GraphPep installation is at /home/g/GraphPep_v1.3. Do not treat /home/g/pepmlm_pipeline as the current workspace.

FoldX.method: RepairPDB followed by AnalyseComplex on chains A/B; use only actual AnalyseComplex A/B Interaction Energy (kcal/mol), lower is more favorable; report parent energy minus variant energy within each seed.
FoldX.settings_to_freeze: temperature 298 K, pH 7.4, ion strength 0.15 M, water -IGNORE, screen false, noNterm false, noCterm false
FoldX.failure: Missing/ambiguous actual Interaction output or any command/input validation error is a failed row; no BuildModel energy substitution.

ESM2_sequence_prior.proposed_formula: Sum over 23 peptide positions of log P(observed amino acid | the same peptide with that position masked), using ESM2 t33 650M UR50D; compare variant minus parent.
ESM2_sequence_prior.meaning: Sequence plausibility baseline only, not an interface or affinity score; report separately and do not interpret positive as improved binding.
ESM2_sequence_prior.implementation_status: Formula proposed; executable scoring wrapper and exact pooling code still need freeze before score execution.

contacts.formula: Count unique receptor-peptide residue pairs having any heavy-atom pair <= 6.0 A on the same relaxed structure; report variant minus parent within seed.
contacts.meaning: Geometry descriptor only; more contacts do not imply stronger affinity.

budgets.two_GiB_interpretation: Operational proposal: cap new pilot artifacts on disk at 2 GiB; the source application did not specify the resource dimension. Stop if exceeded.
budgets.execution_policy: Serial jobs; no PepMLM generation, no model training, no full candidate pool, no paid service, and no remote MSA query.

stop_and_failure_policy: Do not change seeds, replace failed sequences, or omit failed complexes.
Any chain identity/mapping mismatch, low-confidence structure, no-contact structure, unscorable row, or missing seed pair remains a failure in the six-complex count.
Stop at 2 GPU hours or 2 GiB of new artifacts, whichever occurs first.
Do not compute or report pooled correlation or claim scorer validity from these two mutation directions.

Freeze and hash the exact ESM scoring wrapper/pooling implementation before any score is computed.
At run time, verify the active workspace code hashes, generated GraphPep residue mapper hash, FoldX identity, and all six sequence/chain mappings.
